author: ankushindaniil
content: I ran the SPHINCS- verifiers (nconsigny repo, current head) inside a VERIFY frame on nethermind master. Frame gas, without calldata: 101k and 112k for the compact sets, 145k to 155k for SLH-DSA-SHA2-128-24, 209k to 223k for the vanilla h=20 set (264k to 290k with the June verifier); the vanilla sets vary per signature, I ran 20 to 24 each. So these fit under 300k. Under the 100k that is in the spec now, only the smallest one is close: the verifier alone is 96k, and with my wrapper (external call to a cold account) it comes to 101k, so it may fit with the verifier inlined in the account. I could not check your ~360k for 128s, that repo has no 128s verifier. Which parameter set and hash is yours, and is the verifier public? I would like to run it in the same harness.
